---
pagetitle: "Feedback report"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    theme: none
    toc: false
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
        <style>
          :root { --pass:#1a7f4b; --partial:#b7791f; --fail:#c0392b; --review:#5b6770;
                  --ink:#1f2933; --muted:#5b6770; --line:#dde2e7; --bg:#ffffff; --card:#f7f9fa; --code:#e8edf1; }
          @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
            :root { --pass:#4cc38a; --partial:#e0a63c; --fail:#ef7b6d; --review:#9aa5ae;
                    --ink:#e8ecef; --muted:#9aa5ae; --line:#323a42; --bg:#14181c; --card:#1c2228; --code:#2b343c; }
          }
          body { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
                 color: var(--ink); background: var(--bg); line-height: 1.55;
                 max-width: 46rem; margin: 0 auto; padding: 2rem 1rem 4rem; }
          h1 { font-size: 1.6rem; margin: 0 0 .25rem; }
          h2 { font-size: 1.15rem; margin: 2.2rem 0 .75rem; padding-bottom: .3rem;
               border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
          h3 { font-size: 1rem; margin: 0 0 .25rem; }
          .who { color: var(--muted); margin: 0 0 1.5rem; }
          .scorebox { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap;
                      background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--line);
                      border-radius: 10px; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
          .scorebox .big { font-size: 2.4rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; }
          .scorebox .pct { color: var(--muted); font-size: 1.1rem; }
          table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: .95rem; }
          th, td { text-align: left; padding: .5rem .6rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
          th { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 600; }
          .criterion { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-left: 5px solid var(--review);
                       background: var(--card); border-radius: 8px; padding: .8rem 1rem;
                       margin: 0 0 .9rem; }
          .criterion.pass { border-left-color: var(--pass); }
          .criterion.partial { border-left-color: var(--partial); }
          .criterion.fail { border-left-color: var(--fail); }
          .criterion p { margin: .35rem 0; }
          .meta { color: var(--muted); font-size: .9rem; margin: 0 0 .4rem; }
          .errorbox { border: 1px solid var(--fail); border-left-width: 5px;
                      border-radius: 8px; padding: .8rem 1rem; margin: 0 0 1rem; }
          .errorbox .errortitle { font-weight: 700; color: var(--fail); margin: 0 0 .3rem; }
          .errorbox p { margin: .35rem 0; }
          pre { background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px;
                padding: .6rem .8rem; overflow-x: auto; font-size: .85rem; }
          code { font-size: .88em; background: var(--code); padding: .1em .35em; border-radius: 4px; }
          pre code { background: none; padding: 0; }
          .foot { color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; margin-top: 3rem;
                  border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding-top: .8rem; }
        </style>
params:
  student_id: "student"
  assignment: "a1"
  model_rds: ""
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

```{r setup}
# This template uses only base R and knitr, so it renders without the
# ArchGrader package installed. All wording comes from the model built by
# ArchGrader's build_feedback_model(); student text is already escaped.
model <- readRDS(params$model_rds)
say <- function(...) cat(..., sep = "\n")
# The student ID comes from a file name, so escape it before it goes into HTML.
esc_html <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub("\"", "&quot;", x, fixed = TRUE)
}
```

```{r header}
#| output: asis
say(
  paste0("# ", model$title),
  "",
  paste0('<p class="who">Feedback for <strong>', esc_html(model$student_id), "</strong></p>"),
  "",
  '<div class="scorebox">',
  paste0('<span class="big">', model$earned, ' / ', model$possible, '</span>'),
  paste0('<span class="pct">', model$percent, '</span>'),
  "</div>",
  "",
  model$summary,
  ""
)
```

```{r error-section}
#| output: asis
if (!is.null(model$error)) {
  say(
    "::: {.errorbox}",
    paste0('<p class="errortitle">', model$error$title, "</p>"),
    "",
    model$error$text,
    "",
    model$error$message,
    ":::",
    ""
  )
}
```

## Your results

```{r results-table}
#| output: asis
say(knitr::kable(model$table, format = "pipe", align = c("l", "l", "l")), "")
```

## Feedback by criterion

```{r criteria}
#| output: asis
for (b in model$blocks) {
  say(
    paste0("::: {.criterion .", b$status, "}"),
    paste0("### ", b$title),
    "",
    paste0('<p class="meta">', b$points, " points &middot; ", b$status_label, "</p>"),
    "",
    b$comment,
    ""
  )
  if (!is.null(b$details)) say(paste0("*Details:* ", b$details), "")
  if (!is.null(b$hint)) say(paste0("**Hint:** ", b$hint), "")
  if (!is.null(b$where)) say(b$where, "")
  say(":::", "")
}
```

```{r review-section}
#| output: asis
if (length(model$review) > 0) {
  say("## Needs TA review", "",
      "These parts need human judgment and are not scored automatically.", "")
  for (r in model$review) {
    say(paste0("- **", r$title, "** (", r$points, " points)",
               if (!is.null(r$hint)) paste0(": ", r$hint) else ""))
  }
  say("")
}
```

```{r footer}
#| output: asis
say('<p class="foot">Graded automatically by ArchGrader. The same rubric and the same',
    "answers always give the same score.</p>")
```
